entries.11593a99825c8732: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥159,035 million, down ¥192 million from the previous year. While the Newbuilding Business recorded higher revenue, the Ship Repair Business and other businesses recorded lower revenue.
entries.1bb8608ff08466f0: This business engages in software development, ship chartering, wholesale and facility construction, among other activities.
entries.22977059a8c5ee7e: The company's basic strategy is “deepening” its existing businesses and “evolving” through new business development aimed at long-term growth, and it is accelerating growth investment. In the New Shipbuilding Business, the company aims to expand its domestic share of zero-emission vessel construction and targets establishing a system in which the zero-emission vessel construction ratio is 100% before 2040.
entries.2447c586fd9f5dbb: A shipbuilding company that handles the construction and repair of ships, and the manufacture and sale of steel structures and marine machinery.
entries.36246b26ffe67ab9: This business manufactures and sells steel structures, as well as marine machinery such as crankshafts.
entries.3de1dd8c79c7dfda: This is the core business of the group, manufacturing and selling various types of ships. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥125,643 million. In addition to its core handysize bulk carriers, it is advancing the transition to a product-mix shipbuilding structure that also includes large bulk carriers. The company and Hakodate Dock Co., Ltd. are responsible for manufacturing and sales.
entries.3ec71a78ff4e8168: This business engages in software development, ship chartering, wholesale and facility construction, among other activities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,575 million. Namura Information System Co., Ltd. handles software development and sales of information equipment, and three companies, including Morning Daidaras Navigation Co., conduct ship chartering.
entries.403ed0614764d960: A business model in which the company, together with subsidiaries such as Sasebo Heavy Industries and Hakodate Dock, undertakes the manufacture, sale and repair of various ships, and the manufacture and sale of steel structures and marine machinery.
entries.434d1e82d5a46475: Handysize bulk carriers are its mainstay, and it is moving toward a product-mix construction system that combines them with large bulk carriers. It also manufactures and sells marine machinery, such as steel structures and crankshafts for marine engines, and also undertakes ship repairs.
entries.4d8aae83a0339641: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue by customer location was ¥45,981 million for Japan, ¥51,171 million for the Marshall Islands, ¥21,203 million for Liberia and ¥34,632 million for Panama. Revenue from LEPTA SHIPPING CO., LTD. was ¥17,386 million and relates to the Newbuilding Business.
entries.526a4502ad3f284d: The company states that the source of its corporate value lies in close relationships of mutual trust with customers in Japan and overseas built on a long-term perspective, medium- to long-term stable transactional relationships with suppliers of marine equipment and materials, development, technological and production management know-how for developing, receiving orders for and manufacturing high-quality products that accurately meet customer needs, and good mutual relationships with local communities.

entries.edc556b7d6cd27f0: It consists of the company, 13 subsidiaries and 3 associated companies (as of March 31, 2026). Its head office is in Nishi-ku, Osaka City, and the Imari Works, its main shipyard, is in Imari City, Saga Prefecture. Consolidated employees number 2,436.
entries.eed383758eca7820: The segment information prints revenue from external customers by reportable segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026: New Shipbuilding Business ¥125,643 million, Ship Repair Business ¥20,538 million, Steel Structures and Machinery Business ¥6,279 million, Other Businesses ¥6,575 million, and consolidated revenue ¥159,035 million.
entries.fbd867be51118a64: This business repairs and dismantles ships. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,538 million. It is handled by Sasebo Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. and Hakodate Dock Co., Ltd., which repair domestic naval vessels, patrol vessels and U.S. Navy vessels, and also undertake work on technically demanding civilian ships.
entries.fd05abf1d75bdfbd: This business manufactures and sells steel structures, as well as marine machinery such as crankshafts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,279 million. The company mainly manufactures and sells steel structures, and Sasebo Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells marine machinery.
